be conscious of one's faults: A good leader is always conscious of his faults and asks his team for honest advice on how to improve.
好的領導者總是意識到自己的缺點，並向團隊尋求如何改進的誠實建議。
a conscious decision: Moving to the countryside was a conscious decision; we planned it for years because we wanted a quieter life.
搬到鄉下是個有意識的決定；我們計畫了好幾年，因為想要更安靜的生活。
make a conscious effort to: This year I will make a conscious effort to put my phone away and talk more with my family at dinner.
今年我會有意識地努力去把手機收起來，晚餐時多和家人聊天。
health-conscious consumers: More and more health-conscious consumers check food labels for sugar and salt before they buy anything.
越來越多注重健康的消費者在購買任何東西前都會查看食品標示上的糖和鹽含量。
regain consciousness: The driver was knocked out in the accident, but he began to regain consciousness when the ambulance arrived.
那位駕駛在車禍中昏了過去，但救護車抵達時他開始恢復意識。
fashion-conscious: My fashion-conscious sister reads style magazines every week and always wears the latest clothes and shoes.
我那注重時尚的姊姊每週都看時尚雜誌，總是穿著最新款的衣服和鞋子。
three consecutive days: It rained heavily for three consecutive days, so the river rose and several roads near it were closed.
連續三天下大雨，所以河水上漲，附近幾條道路都封閉了。
for the fifth consecutive year: Our school basketball team won the city championship for the fifth consecutive year, without losing once since 2022.
我們學校籃球隊連續第五年贏得市冠軍，自2022年以來一次都沒輸過。
consecutive numbers: The tickets have consecutive numbers, like 101, 102, and 103, so our group can sit together in one row.
這些票是連續數字，像是101、102和103，所以我們這群人可以坐在同一排。
the consequent rise in prices: The typhoon destroyed many farms, and the consequent rise in prices made vegetables too expensive for many families.
颱風摧毀了許多農場，隨之而來的物價上漲讓蔬菜對許多家庭來說太貴了。
consequent upon the decision: Hundreds of workers lost their jobs, a result consequent upon the decision to close the old factory.
數百名工人失去工作，這是因關閉舊工廠的決定而產生的結果。
a conservative estimate: According to a conservative estimate, at least two thousand people attended the concert, and the real number was probably higher.
根據保守的估計，至少有兩千人參加了演唱會，實際人數可能更多。
conservative dress: For the job interview, she chose conservative dress: a plain dark suit, a white shirt, and simple black shoes.
為了工作面試，她選擇了保守的穿著：素色深色套裝、白襯衫和簡單的黑鞋。
a conservative approach: My grandfather takes a conservative approach to money, keeping it in the bank and avoiding any new or risky investments.
我祖父對金錢採取保守的做法，把錢存在銀行，避免任何新的或有風險的投資。
the Conservative Party: In Britain, the Conservative Party and the Labour Party have been the two main political parties for a long time.
在英國，保守黨和工黨長久以來一直是兩大主要政黨。
considerable influence: As the richest man in town, he has considerable influence over local politics, and few officials dare to disagree with him.
身為鎮上最有錢的人，他對地方政治有相當大的影響力，很少官員敢反對他。
a considerable amount of: Learning a new language takes a considerable amount of time, so do not expect to speak fluently in a month.
學一種新語言需要大量的時間，所以別期望一個月就能說得流利。
at considerable expense: The family repaired the old house at considerable expense, spending almost all of their savings on a new roof.
這家人花費巨大修繕老房子，幾乎把所有積蓄都花在新屋頂上。
be considerate of others: We should be considerate of others and keep our voices down when we talk on the phone in the library.
我們應該體貼他人，在圖書館講電話時要放低音量。
It was considerate of you to: It was considerate of you to bring me soup when I was sick in bed; thank you so much for your kindness.
你真體貼，在我生病臥床時帶湯給我；非常謝謝你的好意。
a considerate driver: A considerate driver slows down near schools and always stops to let old people and children cross the street.
為他人著想的駕駛在學校附近會減速，並總是停下來讓老人和小孩過馬路。
be consistent with the evidence: The man's story seems to be consistent with the evidence found at the scene, so the police believe he is telling the truth.
這名男子的說法似乎與現場找到的證據一致，所以警方相信他說的是實話。
a consistent performer: Tom is a consistent performer who scores well in every game, so the coach always puts him on the team.
湯姆是個表現穩定的人，每場比賽都得分不錯，所以教練總是讓他上場。
consistent growth: Thanks to good planning, the small company has shown consistent growth, with sales rising steadily every year for a decade.
多虧了良好的規劃，這家小公司呈現持續穩定的成長，十年來銷售額每年穩定上升。
be consistent in one's approach: Parents should be consistent in their approach to rules, so children know the same behavior always brings the same result.
父母對規矩的做法應該前後一致，這樣孩子才知道同樣的行為總會帶來同樣的結果。
constant interruptions: I couldn't finish my report because of constant interruptions from phone calls and coworkers asking me questions all afternoon.
我無法完成報告，因為整個下午都有電話和同事來問問題，不斷的打擾。
a constant companion: Since she was a little girl, the old dog has been her constant companion, following her everywhere she goes.
從她還是小女孩起，那隻老狗就一直是她始終相伴的夥伴，她走到哪就跟到哪。
at a constant speed: In the science experiment, the toy car moved at a constant speed, never going faster or slower from start to finish.
在科學實驗中，玩具車以恆定速度移動，從頭到尾都沒有變快或變慢。
constant pressure: Working under constant pressure day and night, the young nurse finally felt exhausted and asked her boss for a vacation.
日夜在持續的壓力下工作，這位年輕護理師終於感到精疲力竭，向主管請假休息。
in constant pain: After hurting his back, my uncle was in constant pain for weeks and could hardly sleep or walk.
背部受傷後，我叔叔持續疼痛了好幾週，幾乎無法睡覺或走路。
